note: T-DLY-03a. Avatar Moment scripts. Placeholders only: {first_name}, {why}, {step_title}, {step_minutes}, {smaller_minutes}, {streak_days}, {time_of_day}, {weekly_count}, {routine_win}, {routine_win_days} (T-GOL-03e: the routine activity done on the most days this week, at least 4, by its approved spoken name from content/routine/catalog.json; never a custom item). A variant is used only when every placeholder in it has a value. Invitations, never orders or guilt; about an 8th-grade reading level; one step plus a smaller option. review_status: pending until the clinical team approves; prod uses approved only (dev may use pending). Listed for review in REVIEW.md.
